body:
Investigation confirms the reported task container received SIGKILL during DinD bootstrap (exit 137 after 5.563 seconds), but the surviving log cannot identify the signal sender. If records from the original host still exist, could you attach the container inspect state, Docker events/daemon journal, kernel journal or dmesg, the container cgroup `memory.events`, and `/var/log/dockerd.log` for container `078ba6c799e04800836f7be6e201ba716717d756762e7ffb7fc7c469a4c6a457`?

Separately, the exact incident image reproducibly leaves `docker inspect --size` blocked during this launch path. PR #2245 bounds that optional probe and enables retained DinD startup logs in verbose mode. I reported the size hang upstream with a reproducer, workaround, and fix suggestion: https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/53641
